description: Fork of exp272 (dual-stream residual-LUT, E=96 -> 1.6836 @ 8K). Reduce E 96 -> 64 (matches exp268's lever on exp265 baseline). Keeps d_qk=64, d_v=32 unchanged so attention capacity H*d_qk=384, H*d_v=192 is unchanged; only residual_lut input dim, qk_joint/out_proj input/output dims, and tok_emb_E shrink. residual_lut now projects 64 -> D=384. Comparators: exp272=1.6836 (same recipe at E=96), exp268=1.6350 (same E=64 lever on exp265 baseline). Tests whether the dual-stream design tolerates E=64 the same way the V2D/D2V design did.
